why: Found at the build, before any P5 outcome was compared: rule RC2 of the contract sets the annotated record's triage to 'annotated', but the frozen record schema schemas/result_record.schema.json (v1, which gate G9 validates every record against) admits triage only in finding, intent_question, model_defect and none, so a record carrying RC2's value can never be valid. The amended test reads RC2's mark where the build writes it, the record's annotation (annotation.triage 'annotated', with the annotation's source and text), and the record keeps the triage of a REFUTED record (finding). P5's claim is unchanged: both receives REFUTED and replayed, the Rollup's annotated with the whitepaper's source, the messenger's not. The contract docstring is pinned by sha256 and keeps RC2's wording; the report states the difference.

Correction of the line above: the inconsistency was found after the first local run of the contract tests, in which P5 had passed with RC2's triage 'annotated'; the bundle gate's G9 (v1 validity of every bundle record) then rejected that record. The amendment moves where the test reads the mark, not what P5 claims.

I70 (holon-rules/1.13, landing after I86) chains a new catalog version over the newest below it, so M3 derives with 1.13 and every M3 law, I86's seventeen included, carries rule_catalog_version holon-rules/1.13 (scheme 2: no statement hash moves). C1 asserted catalog_version('M3') == holon-rules/1.11 and took the base as the newest version other than 1.11, which is now a later one: it pinned the literal holon-rules/1.11 as M3's current version, so it turns red at any later catalog bump without saying anything about I86's laws. The amended test keeps I86's claim and drops the pin, as I84's C1 was amended at I86's bump (08431efd): M3 derives with 1.11 or a later version of the chain that holds I86's producers as the same objects, 1.11 holds its six sub-forms, and 1.11's base is the newest version below it.

I70 (holon-rules/1.13): the same bump. C2 asserted each of I86's seventeen laws carries rule_catalog_version holon-rules/1.11; the amended test asserts they carry M3's current catalog version, and keeps the law ids, rules and sub-forms as they were.
